name: Backdrop Transform
description: Upstream-parity backdrop transforms (BackdropTransform, NoBackdropTransform, ScaleBackdropTransform) for sheet/drawer zoom-out effects.

use: you render a pinned sheet or drawer container with a zoom-out backdrop.
you need the freed layout space a backdrop scale produces.
avoid: simple modal overlays without backdrop motion.

examples.minimal:
PinnedSheet(
  backdrop: MyContent(),
  backdropTransform: const ScaleBackdropTransform(),
  child: const DrawerContainer(child: Text('Sheet')),
)

theming: Root corner radius falls back to `Theme.of(context).radiusXxl`.
accessibility: Backdrop transforms are purely visual; keep sheet content reachable.
do: Use `BackdropTransform.none` for sheets that must not move the backdrop.
dont: Stack multiple scaling transforms on the same backdrop layer.
